Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1339
Claimant:
James Castillo
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
7-18-23
Claim opened after the insured reported a collision at an intersection while turning left. The claimant, represented by
counsel, was the other party's passenger and reported neck pain at the scene.
7-22-23
Reviewed the policy declarations and confrimed the driver is named on the policy and the coverage was in force on
the reported loss date.
7-25-23
Police report obtained. Responding officers and a witness statement confirm the claimant was seated in the vehicle at
the time of impact.
8-9-23
Photographs submitted by the insured show the damage to the front quarter panel and bumper, which fits the
described impact angle and speed.
9-27-23
Spoke with the appraiser, who reports no earlier damage to the vehicle is on file and nothing indicates the damage
predates the coverage start.
10-18-23
No independent witnesses have come forward beyond the officer's observations and the statement already on file.
Photos confirm some scene details but not the full sequence.
10-30-23
Medical records received from the claimant's provider. The diagnosis of whiplash and the reported symptoms are
consistent with the force of a collision of this type.
11-12-23
Counsel's demand package references a prior neck strain several years ago. Records show it was minor, in the same
general area, and healed completely with no lasting complaints.
11-18-23
Treatment followed a typical course of physical therapy and medication. Billing and notes show visit frequency
tapering as the claimant's range of motion and pain improved.
12-5-23
Claimant's recorded statement, taken through counsel, adds a few minor details about seating position and the
moment of braking. The core account of the collision has not changed from the initial report.
1-1-24
Reviewed the medical timeline against the vehicle damage and the account. The injury, treatment pattern, and
vehicle damage all line up with the reported loss.
1-30-24
File summary prepared for the supervisor. Liability and coverage are straightforward, and the claimed injury appears
consistent with the documented impact. Next step is to evaluate the settlement demand from counsel.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
